features: Card numbers and IBANs are blurred and removed from all your devices, and from the clipboard, after 5 minutes. You can pick 1, 5 or 15 minutes in Settings.
One-time codes get a "Copy" button that copies just the code.
Links, phone numbers, email addresses and street addresses get one-tap Open, Call, Email and Map buttons.
Smarter search: the best matches come first, small typos are forgiven, and you can search "code", "card", "phone" or "link" to find that kind of clip.
improvements: On Android 13 and later, sensitive clips are hidden in the system's own clipboard preview.
